text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1f2933

g.text: The five departments share a specification frame, not an identical process

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5b6770

g.text: Only the content-generation sub-pipeline in the shaded row was implemented and evaluated (Chapter 5); the other rows are conceptual.
